name: Child Support income
description: Defines how Child Support payments are treated as income for benefit purposes, covering both information share and non-information share Child Support payments with automated income charging rules, deemed receipt, payment cycles, manual income charging rules for historical periods, exemptions, changes and reviews, deprivation, and offsetting provisions.

attributes.summary: Policy guidance on the treatment of Child Support payments as income in the context of benefit eligibility and assessment, including rules for information share and non-information share payments, charging cycles, exemptions, and review processes.
